summary: Linkhome Holdings Inc. filed Form 8-K/A to amend its July 2, 2026 current report on the July 1, 2026 consummation of its acquisition of all issued and outstanding shares of Constant Investments, Inc. (d/b/a Mortgage One Group), a Texas corporation, under a stock purchase agreement dated May 8, 2026, as amended. The amendment only adds Item 9.01(a) audited and interim target financials and Item 9.01(b) pro forma information; it restates no deal economics. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated in this excerpt. Watch integration and purchase-accounting disclosures as the risk-arb angle.
